items.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999
items.q: But she’s got her hands full with my son Jason, you know.

ctx.x: Well she obviously helps you run your business.
She does. If she worked harder at it I’d be even busier. She does it and then sort of gets out of the way. But she’s got her hands full with my son Jason, you know. 15 going on 40.
